critique_history.assessment:
- The marble is overwhelmingly white and densely streaked; make it predominantly dark forest green with sparse, subtle pale veining.
- The basin recess is visually obscured and appears nearly flat; deepen and clearly define the inner bowl and rim.
- The basin’s sides flare too aggressively into a pointed vessel shape; use a broader, softer classic square sink profile.
The model clearly delivers the glossy forest-green veined basin, chrome gooseneck faucet with two handles, and classic tapered pedestal silhouette.
